release_blockers.condition: Written determination of the applicable Live2D Open Software, Proprietary Software and Publication/Expandable Application terms is absent.
release_blockers.exit_criteria: Store the applicable agreement or written vendor determination, NOTICE wording, allowed runtime redistribution scope and any fee/review result in release evidence.

release_blockers.condition: The shipped model lacks a complete original-source and rights packet.
release_blockers.exit_criteria: Provide layered source, Cubism source, runtime export, author/commission contract, prompt and edit provenance, third-party-material declaration, SHA-256 manifest and redistribution grant.

release_blockers.condition: Transparent, always-on-top, click-through, drag-drop and multi-monitor behavior has not passed on every advertised native platform.
release_blockers.exit_criteria: Bind each platform/architecture result to candidate commit, artifact hash, OS version and evidence. Browser fallback does not count.

release_blockers.condition: Cubism/Pixi dependencies and model resources are not pinned, hashed, offline-loadable and covered by SBOM/NOTICE.
release_blockers.exit_criteria: Pin exact runtime versions, vendor only authorized files, verify hashes and prohibit runtime CDN/model downloads.

release_blockers.condition: The pet increases initial startup work or duplicates the desktop runtime.
release_blockers.exit_criteria: No Electron/Tauri/PySide sidecar; pet disabled by default, assets lazy-loaded, no first-screen request, idle CPU and package-size budgets pass.
